description: DB integration (serviceRequestPortalHistory.integration.test.ts): seed a submission with an attachment and audit rows for created, execution_failed (details.error_summary set), mapping_applied, mapping_field_applied, mapping_field_failed and an unknown legacy operation. getClientServiceRequestSubmissionDetail returns exactly [created, execution_failed]; each event has only audit_id/operation/actor_name/timestamp; the detail has no workflow_execution_id, execution_error_summary, definition_id, definition_version_id or definition_version_number keys; the attachment has no file_id. getServiceRequestSubmissionDetailForDefinition for the same submission still returns all six events with details.

Unit (myRequestDetail.page.test.tsx): a failed submission with one named and one unnamed attachment renders the translated 'Failed' badge, the file name and the translated 'Attachment' label, and the translated history labels; rendered text contains no 'Execution status', 'Version', 'Workflow', 'File ID', raw enum or attachment UUID.
Unit (myRequestDetail.page.test.tsx): a submission whose snapshot has no fields renders its payload as label/value rows (dt = key, dd = value) and no <pre> element.

Unit ([definitionId]/page.test.tsx): with initialValues containing a static default for a text field and a context-default UUID under a non-field key, the page renders no 'Initial Values' heading, no version text and no UUID in visible text, while the text field input is prefilled with its default.

Unit (portalDetail toPortalFormView): an advanced-provider detail with executionConfig, formBehaviorConfig rules and version ids maps to an object whose keys are exactly title/description/icon/formSchema/initialValues/visibilityRules, with parsed rules; a basic-provider detail maps to visibilityRules [].

Unit (dashboard.visibility.test.ts harness): a failed service_request_submissions row carrying an error message yields a service_request activity with status 'failed' and description '', and the service request select does not request execution_error_summary.

i18n gates: node scripts/validate-translations.cjs passes after regenerating pseudo-locales; serviceRequestsI18n.integration.test.ts asserts submissionDetail.unnamedAttachment resolves in en and de and no longer references detail.noInitialValues.
